name: Filler jam burst
text: Four filler jams in 45 minutes, soon after a clean.

name: Rejects after changeover
text: Many bad labels after a product change.

name: Capper drift
text: Cap torque slid down for two hours. Rejects rose.

name: Tiny stops after shift change
text: Many 1-2 minute slowdowns just after the 22:00 handover.

name: Slow running
text: The line ran at 70% of ideal speed for 3.5 hours.

name: Preform shortage
text: A preform delivery came very late. The line ran dry.

name: Both lines stop together
text: Both lines stopped for over 20 minutes at the same time.

name: Unexplained dip
text: Score dipped for 80 minutes. No clear cause in the data.
